quarterly_data.signal: Photronics' fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ended May 3, 2026) earnings release: revenue was $209.9 million, down 0.5% year-over-year and down 6.7% sequentially. IC revenue was $147.5 million, down 5% year-over-year and 11% sequentially; the presentation splits it into High-End $56.7M (down 21% Q/Q, 4% Y/Y) and Mainstream $90.9M (down 3% Q/Q, 6% Y/Y). Gross margin was 31.3%, operating margin 20.1%, GAAP diluted EPS $0.54 and non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.42. The CEO said certain design releases were delayed due to elevated fab utilization rates extending new product launch timelines, memory supply constraints and related cost pressures for OEMs, and geopolitical uncertainty.
quarterly_data.figure: FQ2 2026 revenue $209.9 million (-0.5% YoY, -6.7% QoQ); IC $147.5 million (-5% YoY, -11% QoQ): High-End $56.7M, Mainstream $90.9M; gross margin 31.3%; operating margin 20.1%; EPS $0.54 GAAP / $0.42 non-GAAP

quarterly_data.signal: Photronics guided fiscal Q3 2026 revenue between $207 million and $215 million, operating margin between 18% and 20% and non-GAAP diluted EPS between $0.39 and $0.45, assuming delayed design starts because of tight memory conditions. The presentation says the Allen, Texas facility is to begin delivering qualification masks in FQ3 and that fiscal 2026 capex reflects latter stages of expansion in the U.S., initial expansion in South Korea and peak end-of-life tool replacement; FQ2 capex of $45.8 million primarily reflected outlays for the Korea node extension down to 8nm, end-of-life tool upgrades, facility optimization and Allen expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: FQ3 2026 revenue $207 million-$215 million; operating margin 18%-20%; non-GAAP EPS $0.39-$0.45; FQ2 capex $45.8 million
